sources.notes: Retain roughly two-thirds of rounded lumpy shell including complete back and underside, remove bounded front/top wedge for visibility. Wall has exterior rind, finite thickness and pale inner chalcedony liner. Crystals attach to inner concave surface and point toward cavity center, irregular spacing/size, short enough to preserve empty hollow; mostly creamy quartz, no unsupported amethyst claim. Cut opening is a deliberate educational display convention frozen before modeling; not claimed natural break or bedrock cave. No pedestal or slab. Concept inspected: rounded free enclosing nodule and hollow read correctly. Concept crystals too large/coarse; final lining uses substantially smaller unequal quartz crystals, preserving empty inward hollow. Opening reinterpreted as honest removed front/top display cap, no natural break claim.
